Visit note | 2025-11-10 10:00 AM | Dr. Ishrat Jahan, Psychiatry | Patient: Ziaur Molla, 32, male. Mr. Molla attends for review, reporting that he has experienced constant worry for months, along with feeling restless and experiencing poor sleep. He works as a journalist and notes his symptoms have become worse since a family business loss in Badda. He reports taking his current medicines regularly and denies any sudden panic attacks or low mood. On examination: GAD-7 score 12, BP 134/81 mmHg, pulse 78 bpm, weight 51 kg. Plan: chronic follow-up: continue current medicines, no new prescription issued today. He was advised to practise slow breathing daily, reduce tea and coffee, and start counselling sessions. Follow-up in 4 weeks.
